requirements.summary: Remove the FocusGuard logo from the Header component that was added in Version 6
acceptanceCriteria: The logo image or logo component is removed from the Header component
The header displays only navigation buttons and theme toggle as in Version 5

file_operations.description: Remove the logo/brand image element from the Header component. Keep only the navigation links (Home, Timer, Dashboard) and the ThemeToggle component. Ensure the header layout remains centered and functional without the logo branding.

requirements.summary: Revert Dashboard component styling to Version 5 appearance by removing enhanced visual depth and refined card shadows
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard uses the simpler card-based layout from Version 5 without the enhanced depth effects
Background contrasts and shadow refinements from Version 6 are removed

file_operations.description: Simplify card shadows and remove enhanced depth styling from metric cards, graph containers, and insight sections. Revert to Version 5's simpler shadow classes and background treatments. Remove any gradient backgrounds or refined contrast enhancements added in Version 6.
Remove or simplify the gradient background styling to match Version 5's simpler page background. Revert any enhanced container styling or depth effects that were added in Version 6.

requirements.summary: Restore light mode theming to Version 5 color palette by reverting soft gray/tinted backgrounds and gentle shadows
acceptanceCriteria: Light mode uses the Version 5 color scheme
Soft gray backgrounds and refined shadows from Version 6 are removed
All components display with Version 5 light mode styling

file_operations.description: Revert the light mode CSS custom properties to Version 5 values. Remove soft gray/tinted backgrounds and refined shadow definitions that were added in Version 6. Restore the simpler, higher-contrast light mode color scheme from Version 5.
Remove or revert any Version 6 shadow utilities, color refinements, or OKLCH color enhancements in the light mode theme configuration. Restore Version 5's simpler shadow scale and color definitions.

requirements.summary: Restore dark mode theming to Version 5 appearance by reverting deep dark backgrounds and refined card contrast
acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode uses the Version 5 color scheme
Enhanced background depth and card contrast from Version 6 are removed
All components display with Version 5 dark mode styling

file_operations.description: Revert the dark mode CSS custom properties to Version 5 values. Remove deep dark backgrounds and refined card contrast enhancements from Version 6. Restore the simpler dark mode color palette that existed in Version 5.
Remove or revert any Version 6 dark mode theme refinements including enhanced background depth utilities and refined contrast settings. Restore Version 5's simpler dark mode configuration.
